race.comment: JOEJOE (3) has returned from his spell in good order with a pair of second place finishes, the most recent 10 days ago at Hobart by a head, after sharing the pace. He cops a tougher gate for his peak run, but he can still go one better. ROUSING LEVI (6) has improved in each of his 2 starts back from a spell, and was second by less than a length at Hobart last time out. He dons the blinkers for the first time, and from a superior gate, he can take this out. RAMIRO (9) set the pace, and folded up when headed here nearly 5 weeks ago when resuming from a spell. He was well in the market that day, and despite copping a wide draw here, he is worth another chance, especially with Troy Baker picking up the ride. TIMMIE LAD (7) is another who will be having the blinkers on for the first time, and his efforts this prep have been near enough. He is peaking at the right time, and well worth keeping safe in all combos. GEEGEES BIG BIRD (2) is on his last chance with Darmanin in the saddle.
